title: Paul McCartney live: AAMI Park, Melbourne | 2017
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the AAMI Park in Melbourne, Australia, on 6 December 2017.

Just a few of you here at @AAMIPark tonight Melbourne! #OneOnOne @PaulMcCartney pic.twitter.com/QhMHZDh31O

— Frontier Touring (@frontiertouring) December 6, 2017

It was the 73rd show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017, and the second of two consecutive nights in Melbourne.

We’ve been waiting to get back to Australia and New Zealand for years and now it’s finally happening. It is very exciting. I’m really looking forward to the concerts as we’ve always had such a brilliant time whenever we’ve been before so we know we are in for a treat. Can’t wait to see you and all rock out together.
Paul McCartney
paulmccartney.com

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums). As on the previous night, they were joined by the Scotch College Pipe Band for ‘Mull Of Kintyre’.

I forgot most of my questions cos what is life?! @PaulMcCartney is a total gentleman. Full IV next week on @TheProject_NZ pic.twitter.com/TOIFCsN7au

— Jaquie Brown (@JaquieBrown) December 6, 2017
